scenes.title: Another opening-hours enquiry?
scenes.narration: Running a small restaurant? Repeated customer questions can interrupt the work in front of you.

scenes.title: A fictional example
scenes.narration: Here is Little Lotus, a fictional Vietnamese restaurant. These example details are invented for this demonstration.

scenes.title: Start with approved details
scenes.narration: Our example opening time is noon. Dietary questions must go to a staff member for checking.
scenes.visual: Missing recording: approved business information sheet

scenes.title: Customer asks a question
scenes.narration: A customer asks: what time do you open, and can you handle a peanut allergy?

scenes.title: Write a careful draft
scenes.narration: My manually written draft says: we open at noon. Please ask our team about your allergy before ordering.

scenes.title: Keep a human check
scenes.narration: The limit: this is a text mock-up, not a tested chatbot. No allergy assurance should be automated.

scenes.title: Test before making claims
scenes.narration: Next, I would test draft replies against real, sanitised questions. I have not measured any time savings.

scenes.title: Start with one enquiry type
scenes.narration: Want to explore a narrow enquiry-drafting pilot? Bring one repeated question and your approved business information.
